summary: fractal alerts is the CLI alert surface; the attention alias and retired alerts request command are removed

replay.detail: No replay, backfill or stored data change.

schema.detail: No database or client schema change.

rules.detail: No claim, checkpoint, retention or authority rule change.

compatibility.detail: Use fractal alerts instead of attention, and work ask or work update instead of alerts request. POST /v1/attention is removed; attention READ endpoints, durable IDs and historical claims remain readable. Alert resolve and withdraw retain their informational-update and delegated source actions.

downtime.detail: Ordinary rolling deployment; no data conversion or extra startup work.

manual.detail: Update CLI callers to alerts before upgrading. The delivery soak records failures in its journal and report state instead of posting retired attention mutations.

recovery.detail: Swap back freely; nothing is stored.
